modern: The perfection of moral character consists in this: in living every day as if it were the last, and in being neither violently excited, nor sluggish, nor playing the hypocrite.
original: The perfection of moral character consists in this, in passing every day as the last, and in being neither violently excited nor torpid nor playing the hypocrite.
